title: Bone regeneration using composite non -demineralized xenogenic dentin with beta-tricalcium phosphate in experimental alveolar cleft repair in a rabbit model
authors: Kamal M, Andersson L, Tolba R, Al -Asfour A, Bartella AK, Gremse F, Rosenhain S, Hölzle F, Kessler P, Lethaus B. J Transl Med. 2017 Dec 23;15(1):263. doi: 10.1186/s12967-017-1369-3.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Composite xenogenic dentin/β-TCP putty expresses enhanced bone regeneration compared to β -TCP alone in the reconstruction of rabbit alveolar clefts defects. 13” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
